notes.title: Version 1.0.6 Update
notes.content:
Released Update v1.0.6

Thank you for playing Ancient Sacrifice.

We have implemented several fixes based on bug reports and added new features. In version 1.0.6, we have made the following changes:

Fixed some text issues
Adjusted enemy AI
Added High-Speed Mode

High-Speed Mode can be toggled at any time from the options menu. 
A pop-up will appear upon first launch to inform you about this feature.

Thank you for your continued support.

notes.title: Release date of "Ancient Sacrifice" has been set for July 3rd!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43406797/12c7b3bde77e00ea24ad15bda5f0ac9e586f9254.jpg

What is Ancient Sacrifice?
Ancient Sacrifice is a real-time card battle game. Players build their own unique deck of cards and battle against each other based on the cards they obtain as the story progresses.

Ancient Sacrifice is being developed by jag games, a solo game developer. The game uses a lot of AI for images and music, and has a UI with a different taste from existing games.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43406797/5802e9d214a2abb10bb78afcdedcec771c1f0041.jpg

Features of Ancient Sacrifice
Real-time card battles
Dark fantasy storyline
Full use of AI (images, background music, scenario, etc.)
Deck-building is possible; you only need to select 10 cards for your deck.
More than 100 types of cards, more than 40 types of various skills
Skills are simple and easy to understand


Other
You may use any of the materials on the Steam page and information in this document.
All distribution on Youtube and other sites, as well as live performances, are acceptable.

notes.title: Notice of indefinite suspension of development
notes.content:
Notice of indefinite suspension of development


Thank you very much for your interest.
Thank you very much for playing the trial version.

We have made a comprehensive decision based on the policy regarding AI images announced by Steam,
We have decided that AncientSacrifice, which is currently being created with full use of Midjourney, will not be able to be released into production.

Therefore, we have decided to suspend development indefinitely until the situation changes.
We will continue to develop Midjourney when we have a better chance of being able to release it, such as when the policies of Midjourney are disclosed.

We are very sorry for those who have been waiting for the release of Midjourney.
Please accept our apologies to those who have been waiting for the release of Midjourney, and we apologize for any inconvenience this may cause.


jag games.

notes.title: Released! Demo Version of "Ancient Sacrifice"
notes.content:
About the Trial Version of Ancient Sacrifice
The demo version of Ancient Sacrifice, which  released on March 15, will allow you to play several battle scenes of Ancient Sacrifice. The total time is about 15 to 30 minutes, so please feel free to pick it up.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43406797/1fc4241ee0d58e182e880ae8549153005b2708f5.png


EVENTS
If you upload a screenshot of this demo version to Twitter with the hashtag #AncientSacrifice, we will hold a drawing to use your name on a card that will be implemented in the full release version of the game!
We look forward to your participation.
